words.example: I recommend a written handover note for every weekend cover.
words.exampleZh: 我建议每次周末顶班都留一份书面交接说明。

words.example: I suggest we start the bed meeting with today's discharges.
words.exampleZh: 我提议床位会先从今天的出院情况谈起。

words.example: I propose moving the quality meeting to Wednesday afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 我提出把质量会改到周三下午。

words.example: She will present the complaint themes at the quality meeting.
words.exampleZh: 她会在质量会上汇报这几类投诉。

words.example: Please report any lost badge to security the same day.
words.exampleZh: 工牌丢失请在当天向保卫报告。

words.example: Safe mode on this clinic PC let us remove the faulty scanner driver.
words.exampleZh: 这台门诊电脑进了安全模式，我们才卸掉了有问题的扫描驱动。

words.meaning: 基本输入输出系统（Basic Input/Output System）
words.example: BIOS (Basic Input/Output System) on the new scanner is too old for this disk.
words.exampleZh: 新扫描仪的BIOS（基本输入输出系统）太旧，认不了这块盘。

words.meaning: 统一固件接口（Unified Extensible Firmware Interface）
words.example: UEFI (Unified Extensible Firmware Interface) failed to boot the server from the new disk.
words.exampleZh: UEFI（统一固件接口）没能让这台服务器从新磁盘启动。

words.example: Firmware on the fiber switch is the version known to drop storage paths.
words.exampleZh: 光纤交换机上的固件正是已知会丢掉存储路径的那个版本。

words.example: The driver for the barcode scanner crashes after each Windows update.
words.exampleZh: 每次 Windows 更新之后，条码扫描枪的驱动程序都会崩溃。
